zotero.abstractNote: We present the LIGO A♯ detector concept, an upgrade for the LIGO observatories based on room-temperature technology that aims to improve the sensitivity of the current A+ configuration by a factor of approximately 2.5 in strain, corresponding to a factor of ~15 in volume reach. This upgrade will enable the detection of binary black hole mergers out to redshifts of z ~ 10 and binary neutron star mergers out to z ~ 0.5, providing unprecedented opportunities for studying the population, evolution, and formation of compact objects, as well as testing general relativity in the strong-field regime.
